title: ModelExtractionPayload
description: The semantic claim fields produced by an LLM. This is NOT a candidate — it lacks pipeline-generated identity, document reference, producer metadata, and timestamps. EVIDENCE CONTRACT: the model provides UNTRUSTED exact verbatim quotes (evidence_quotes); it never provides numeric character offsets. The pipeline anchors each quote in raw_text deterministically and derives the trusted source_spans (start/end/text) itself — see the extraction-candidate schema. A model-supplied source_spans field is rejected by additionalProperties.

subject.description: The entity or concept the claim is about. E.g. 'Spanish electricity market', 'RDL 10/2022'.

predicate.description: The relationship or property being asserted. E.g. 'has_average_price', 'was_published_on', 'sets_cap_at'.

value.description: The asserted value as stated in the document. May be null when the document explicitly states the value is unknown or not applicable.

value_raw.description: The exact text from the document that states the value, before any normalization. Preserves what the document says verbatim.

unit_raw.description: The unit as written in the document, before normalization. E.g. 'EUR/MWh', '€/MWh', 'megawatts', 'percent'. Null when the document does not specify a unit.

unit_canonical.description: The canonical unit after normalization, if deterministically mappable. Null when no canonical mapping exists or when not applicable.

definition.description: Optional clarification of what the subject/predicate/value combination means, especially when the document defines a term.

geography.description: Geographic scope of the claim as stated in the document. E.g. 'Spain', 'Iberian Peninsula', 'EU'. Null when not applicable.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 date when the claim became valid in the world, as stated in the document. Null when the document does not specify.

valid_to.description: ISO 8601 date when the claim ceased to be valid, as stated in the document. Null when open-ended or unspecified.

evidence_quotes.description: Exact verbatim quotes copied character-for-character from the source document, supporting this claim. At least one quote is required. Each quote must occur EXACTLY ONCE in the document (choose a long enough excerpt to be unique). The pipeline derives character offsets deterministically from these quotes; the model must NEVER supply offsets. Quotes are untrusted until anchored: a quote not found in the document is rejected (quote_not_found); a quote occurring more than once is rejected (ambiguous_quote).

confidence.description: Model self-assessed confidence in this extraction, 0.0 to 1.0.
